theory_refs.at: Recomputing k elements when only 2 changed
theory_refs.why: The bottleneck behind every fixed window.

theory_refs.at: Add, remove, record — in that order

stages.title: Understand
stages.body:
✍️ f(array, k) → the maximum average of any contiguous subarray of length exactly k.
- n ≤ 10⁵, k ≤ n, values ±10⁴.
- [1,12,−5,−6,50,3], k = 4 → 12.75 ((12 − 5 − 6 + 50) / 4).

stages.title: Analyse
stages.body:
✍️ Max average with fixed length = max sum / k. So find the max window sum.
✍️ By hand: the window [1,12,−5,−6] has sum 2. Sliding right: remove 1, add 50 → 51. I never re-add the middle three.
✍️ Edges: k = n (one window); k = 1 (max element); all negative.

stages.title: Brainstorm: brute → optimal
stages.body:
✍️ **1. Brute.** Sum each of the n−k+1 windows from scratch. O(n·k) → up to 10¹⁰ when k ≈ n/2.
✍️ ↳ Bottleneck: consecutive windows share k−1 elements, but each is re-summed.
✍️ **2. Optimal.** Maintain the window sum: + entering, − leaving. O(n), O(1).
✍️ (Prefix sums also work: window sum = pre[i+1] − pre[i−k+1], O(n) time but O(n) space.)

stages.title: Algorithm in words
stages.body:
✍️ 1. Walk i from 0 to n−1, adding a[i] to the window sum.
✍️ 2. Once i ≥ k, subtract a[i−k], the element that just left.
✍️ 3. Once i ≥ k−1 (the first full window), update the best sum.
✍️ 4. Return best / k.

stages.title: Pseudocode
stages.body:
```
STATE   win = 0; best = -infinity
LOOP    for i in 0..n-1
UPDATE    win += a[i]
          if i >= k: win -= a[i-k]
CHECK     if i >= k-1: best = max(best, win)
RETURN  best / k   (as double)
```

stages.title: Reference C++
Edge cases and complexity
stages.body:
✍️ O(n) time, O(1) space.
✍️ Initialise best to −∞ (or the first window), not 0 — all-negative windows exist.
- Divide once at the end; comparing averages each step adds float error for nothing.

stages.title: Carry forward
stages.body:
✍️ "Subarray of length k" → fixed window: one add, one remove, record when full.
✍️ Max average with fixed length = max sum.

stages.title: Interview follow-ups
stages.body:
- *Length at least k* (LeetCode 644, Hard): binary search on the average + prefix sums (beyond this plan).
- *Count windows with average ≥ threshold* (LeetCode 1343): same window, compare sum ≥ threshold·k.

siblings.title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Given Length
siblings.maps: Same fixed window; the summary is a vowel count instead of a sum.

stages.title: Analyse
stages.body: ✍️ Max number of vowels in any substring of length k.

stages.title: Brainstorm
stages.body: ✍️ Recount each window → O(n·k). Maintain the vowel count: +1 if the entering char is a vowel, −1 if the leaving char is. O(n).

stages.title: Algorithm in words
stages.body: ✍️ Fixed-window skeleton with "is vowel" as the value of each character.

stages.title: Pseudocode
stages.body:
```
cnt = 0; best = 0
for i: cnt += vowel(s[i]); if i >= k: cnt -= vowel(s[i-k]); if i >= k-1: best = max(best, cnt)
```

stages.title: Reference C++
Quick theory
stages.body: ✍️ Any additive summary (sum, count of a property) slides in O(1) ([[sw-fixed-window#variations]]).

siblings.title: K Radius Subarray Averages
siblings.maps: Window of size 2k+1 centred at i; the answer is written at the centre, not the right end.

stages.title: Analyse
stages.body: ✍️ avg[i] = integer average of a[i−k..i+k], or −1 if that range leaves the array.

stages.title: Brainstorm
stages.body: ✍️ Fixed window of size w = 2k+1 with a long long sum; when the window [i−w+1, i] is full, write sum / w at position i−k.

stages.title: Algorithm in words
stages.body: ✍️ Initialise all answers to −1; slide; assign at the centre.

stages.title: Pseudocode
stages.body:
```
w = 2k+1; sum = 0; out = [-1]*n
for i: sum += a[i]; if i >= w: sum -= a[i-w]; if i >= w-1: out[i-k] = sum / w
```

stages.title: Reference C++
Quick theory
stages.body: ✍️ Sums of 10⁵ values up to 10⁵ reach 10¹⁰ → long long ([[cpp-integer-overflow#where]]).

siblings.title: Number of Sub-arrays of Size K and Average Greater than or Equal to Threshold
siblings.maps: Count fixed windows whose sum ≥ threshold × k.

stages.title: Analyse
stages.body: ✍️ Count windows of size k whose average is at least the threshold.

stages.title: Brainstorm
stages.body: ✍️ Compare sums with threshold·k (no division). Fixed window, O(n).

stages.title: Algorithm in words
stages.body: ✍️ Slide the window; count each full window that meets the target sum.

stages.title: Pseudocode
stages.body:
```
target = threshold * k; sum = 0; cnt = 0
for i: sum += a[i]; if i >= k: sum -= a[i-k]; if i >= k-1 and sum >= target: cnt++
```

stages.title: Reference C++
Quick theory
stages.body: ✍️ Turn average comparisons into sum comparisons to stay in integers.
